application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of detached single storey outbuilding to the rear of the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Proposed Greenhouse Location Plan; Location Plan; PANT5000_GP  Received:  24 March 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwelling, excluding as a bedroom, kitchen or bathroom, self-contained dwelling or commercial office space used by external employees.
